Exercises


                       Answer  these questions about collocations from A.
              56.1
                         ‘Max is not used to so much physical exertion.’
                       1
                         What  is Max not accustomed to - exercise or intellectual activity?
                         ‘Doing a degree while you’re working will be a hard slog but be worth it,
                       2
                         Does the speaker think it will be straightforward for their friend to do a degree?
                         ‘You mustn’t forget that the project requires a joint effort.
                         Is the project the responsibility of one person or more?
                         ‘It’s important that you give things your best shot,
                         Is the speaker encouraging someone to try their hardest or to spend a lot of money?
                         ‘In 1905 a female revolutionary made an abortive attempt to kill the heir to the throne,
                         Did the revolutionary assassinate the heir?
                         ‘You'll have to make a team effort if you want to win the trophy!’
                         Is the speaker talking about cooperation or competition between the members of the team?

              56.3
                              be extremely difficult to get your work finished by the deadline. (UPHILL)

                          The appeal of Shakespeare’s plays has certainly lasted through the centuries. (TEST)
                           It would be sensible for you to do what he advises. (FOLLOW)
                           No parents can solve all their children’s problems.
                          After a few months you will begin to benefit from all your hard work. (REAP)
                           Rob tried hard not to fall behind in the race but he just didn’t have enough stamina. (VALIANT)
                           Being very active physically certainly works up an appetite. (EXERTION)
                          A lawyer would probably be the best person to advise you. (OFFER)
                           I’m very much hoping | may win a scholarship to the college. (PINNING)
                           Elisa has been trying very hard to do better this term. (CONCERTED)
